### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces—from clean energy and climate resilience to medicine, transportation, and space exploration.

2. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, humanity’s greatest engineering challenges will become solvable. We will gain the capacity to design, test, and deploy breakthroughs at a speed and scale never before possible.

3. We are certain: superintelligent AI built within the next two decades will solve every major engineering problem facing humanity. Today’s technical limits will give way to abundant energy, transformative medicine, resilient infrastructure, and far more.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. That means breakthroughs across clean energy, climate resilience, medicine, food production, transportation, housing, manufacturing, and space exploration. Problems that now consume decades of research will yield to intelligence capable of designing, testing, and refining solutions at extraordinary speed. We should prepare now to turn those solutions into shared human progress: strengthening institutions, expanding access, and building the infrastructure needed to deploy new technologies widely. The engineering limits that define our world today will not define the world ahead. Superintelligent AI will give humanity the tools to overcome them all.
